findings.what: The cited name `Causal.SubExtension.isConnected_of_curves` does not exist: `#check` fails with unknown identifier. The lemma is `Causal.isConnected_of_curves`, in the module Causal.SubExtension (Causal/SubExtension.lean:307, under section SubExtension, not a namespace). The REPORT already had this wrong in round 1; I missed it in AUDIT-1. It now graduates inside a docstring.

The text says 'shrink the base of the box so that each vertical fibre below the graph is an interval'. Those fibres are always intervals, possibly empty. Shrinking the base, by continuity of f, is what makes every fibre non-empty, each containing a common segment below f(p). That is what makes V ∩ U₁ preconnected. As written, the stated condition does not give the conclusion.
findings.fix: Write '… is a non-empty interval' (or '… contains a common segment below the graph').
